import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int totalParts, totalMembers, modVal;
    static int[][] binom;
    static boolean[] visited2;
    static State[] memo2;
    static boolean[][] visited1;
    static State[][] memo1;

    static class State {
        int countWays, totalSum;
        State() {
            this.countWays = 0;
            this.totalSum = 0;
        }
        State(int c, int s) {
            this.countWays = c;
            this.totalSum = s;
        }
    }

    static int sumInterval(int a, int b) {
        return (a + b) * (b - a + 1) / 2;
    }

    static State compute2(int n) {
        if (n == 1) return new State(2, 0);
        if (visited2[n]) return memo2[n];
        State res = new State(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int leftCount = i;
            int rightCount = n - i - 1;
            State leftRes = (leftCount == 0) ? new State(1, 0) : compute2(leftCount);
            State rightRes = (rightCount == 0) ? new State(1, 0) : compute2(rightCount);
            int ways = (leftCount + 1) + (rightCount + 1);
            int sumAdd = sumInterval(0, leftCount) + sumInterval(0, rightCount);
            int mlt = binom[leftCount + rightCount][leftCount];
            res.countWays = (int)((res.countWays + (long)leftRes.countWays * ways % modVal * rightRes.countWays) % modVal);
            res.totalSum = (int)((res.totalSum + (long)leftRes.totalSum * ways % modVal * rightRes.countWays
                        + (long)leftRes.countWays * sumAdd % modVal * rightRes.countWays
                        + (long)leftRes.countWays * ways % modVal * rightRes.totalSum) % modVal);
        }
        visited2[n] = true;
        memo2[n] = res;
        return res;
    }

    static State compute1(int idx, int cnt) {
        if (totalParts - idx == cnt) return compute2(cnt);
        if (visited1[idx][cnt]) return memo1[idx][cnt];
        State res = new State(0, 0);
        for (int i = idx; i < totalParts; ++i) {
            int leftCount = i - idx;
            int rightCount = cnt - leftCount;
            if (rightCount < 0 || rightCount > totalParts - i - 1) continue;
            State leftRes = (i == idx) ? new State(1, 0) : compute2(leftCount);
            State rightRes = (i + 1 == totalParts) ? new State(1, 0) : compute1(i + 1, rightCount);
            int mlt = binom[leftCount + rightCount][leftCount];
            res.countWays = (int)((res.countWays + (long)leftRes.countWays * rightRes.countWays % modVal * mlt) % modVal);
            res.totalSum = (int)((res.totalSum + (long)leftRes.totalSum * rightRes.countWays % modVal * mlt
                        + (long)leftRes.countWays * rightRes.totalSum % modVal * mlt) % modVal);
        }
        visited1[idx][cnt] = true;
        memo1[idx][cnt] = res;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int ncomp = sc.nextInt();
        int npers = sc.nextInt();
        int MOD = sc.nextInt();

        totalParts = ncomp;
        totalMembers = npers;
        modVal = MOD;

        binom = new int[ncomp + 1][ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            binom[i][0] = 1;
            binom[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
                binom[i][j] = (binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        visited2 = new boolean[ncomp + 1];
        memo2 = new State[ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            memo2[i] = new State();
        }

        visited1 = new boolean[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];
        memo1 = new State[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= npers; ++j) {
                memo1[i][j] = new State();
            }
        }

        System.out.println(compute1(0, npers).totalSum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
